items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: I've heard of Jim Humphrey, that's the grandfather of Percy and all that.

ctx.x: Yeah. The older musicians anyhow, they all took lessons from Dave Perkins. And well, then some of them I mean I did went to Professor Humphrey a while but I didn't go there too long. Well I've heard of Jim Humphrey, that's the grandfather of Percy and all that. Yeah that's right, well I didn't go there too long. I went there just a short while.
You did take a few lessons?
